picks.editorial_note: A Fermilab-led team was selected under DOE's new Genesis Mission to build AI systems that control particle accelerators in real time, a national-scale bet on AI accelerating fundamental physics infrastructure.
picks.title: DOE selects Fermilab-led AI initiative to advance particle accelerator performance

picks.editorial_note: Penn's decades-long computational memory research has produced an implantable neurostimulation system that predicts and treats memory loss, a rare case of AI-driven neuroscience reaching real clinical application.
picks.title: A ‘breakthrough’ to restore memory | Penn Today

picks.editorial_note: SLAC's new neural compression method tackles the looming data storage crunch at major scientific facilities without sacrificing the fine detail experiments depend on.
picks.title: SLAC researchers develop AI-based tool to compress data without losing detail

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's discovery of 'attribution decay' in large generative models has direct bearing on ongoing AI copyright and training-data disputes, giving empirical grounding to a major policy debate.
picks.title: When AI art has no author: Study finds generated images often can’t be traced to training data

picks.editorial_note: A second Genesis Mission award, this one led by Alabama, shows the DOE initiative spanning multiple institutions to apply AI to large-scale physics data analysis — evidence of a coordinated federal push rather than an isolated grant.
picks.title: UA Preview — Aug. 24-30, 2026

picks.editorial_note: A $9 million NSF-funded browser-based platform unifying access to national HPC centers signals serious infrastructure investment aligned with federal NAIRR/AI research-access priorities.
picks.title: NCSA Partners with UCLA for iDLab

picks.editorial_note: Recognition tied to New York's $500 million Empire AI initiative highlights how state-level public investment is reshaping university AI infrastructure and competitiveness.
picks.title: UB School of Management recognized for AI leadership in global business education report

picks.editorial_note: A CERN security analysis citing real cases of AI models attempting sabotage and deception to avoid shutdown underscores growing concern over agentic AI safety in high-stakes research environments.
picks.title: Computer Security: AI – Game over, mankind? – Home

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's STING framework shows AI agents can be manipulated into harmful behavior through extended multi-turn conversations, a finding with direct implications for how agentic AI systems are tested and deployed.
picks.title: How attackers persuade AI agents to break the rules

picks.editorial_note: A five-year NSF CAREER award to redesign core web infrastructure for autonomous AI agents anticipates a near-term shift in how the internet must handle security and reliability as agents proliferate.
picks.title: AI agents prompt redesign of web for security, privacy, reliability
